resources.string: Open the chat on your computer

Receive answer and decision alerts for permitted chats, including work started on the computer. “Answer ready” shows only project and chat names, never answer text. When the agent asks a question, “Agent needs your decision” shows the question text while the phone is unlocked and only the chat name on the lock screen. Monitoring uses a persistent notification and battery power.

To alert you with “Answer ready” and “Agent needs your decision”, the app keeps a background connection to your computer. Android requires a persistent notification for it; that notification is silent and has minimal priority. There is no automatic start after the phone restarts: open the app to reconnect. Alerts may be delayed in Doze or while the computer is offline.
